history.summary: Freehold 393-unit D15 Siglap development (2014/2015), 2BR at $2.00M / $1,674psf on a roomy 1,195sqft. Well-maintained hilltop estate with active en-bloc interest. Solid 4.62% URA over 109 transactions, frontier, strong arena score (769). Asking PSF sits well below the $1,898 median — value for a freehold in a deep East Coast buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Freehold in tightly-held Siglap/East Coast with a clean 4.62%/yr URA (109 txns, no bias), priced at $1,674psf vs a $1,898 median — a real discount, partly because the 1,195sqft layout is generous (low PSF, not low quality). 393 units and FH status give durable liquidity; reviews describe it as quiet, well-managed and family-friendly. En-bloc interest provides genuine optionality. The $2.00M quantum is the practical ceiling of the deep-pool band but still saleable. Strongest freehold value in the batch.
red_flags: $2.00M quantum at the upper edge of the deepest buyer band
En-bloc is optionality, not a certainty — FCL still holds majority
No MRT within easy walk (relies on buses/drive)
catalysts: Active en-bloc interest — freehold Siglap site with redevelopment appeal
Freehold + deep East Coast buyer pool = durable resale liquidity
Asking PSF ~12% under URA median provides a value cushion
